quotes.text: Graph Calendar delta refresh queues local event changes in order, reuses a pending operation, and advances `syncStateToken` only after the changes succeed. The next patch implements `calIChangeLog`, stores the token in offline storage metadata, and uses that storage as the backing calendar when present. A failed/partial sync must not advance the token or lose changes on retry. https://github.com/t
